Subject: MAP checkpoint — performance benchmarking: latency & throughput snapshot

Hi Sarah / Acme team,

Quick weekly MAP checkpoint following the evaluation runs we promised. Objective: confirm where the latency/throughput profile sits against your SLOs and call out immediate tuning steps so we can keep to the close timeline (EOW May 21).

Summary of latest runs (attached: acme_map_run_20270510.csv, latency-traces-5-10.jsonl):
- Model variant: redwood-gpt-medium-q4 (8-bit)
- Test harness: synthetic chat workload (avg prompt length 120 tokens, 4 concurrent flows)
- Key numbers (p50 / p95 / throughput reqs/s):
  • p50 latency: 65 ms / token
  • p95 latency: 210 ms / token
  • sustained throughput: 38 reqs/s (95th percentile concurrency cap triggered)

Notes: p95 is above your target (target p95 <= 150 ms/token) during sustained bursts. Most of the tail appears correlated with large context evictions and KV cache warmups. We also saw two outlier traces (attached) where backend GC + transient GPU throttling aligned.

Proposed immediate actions (we should decide owners this week):
1) KV prefetch + warmup on canary path (short-term) — owner: Monica. Target: reduce p95 by ~25% for warm-started flows. ETA: 3 business days.
2) Batch size tuning in Dedicated config (reduce max batch windows for latency-critical routes) — owner: Markus. ETA: 2 business days.
3) Kernel/quantization variant trial (q4 -> hybrid q3/q4 on hot layers) — owner: Redwood Research (linking Laura). ETA: spike by Fri 5/14.
4) Add lightweight client-side retry/backoff to avoid simultaneous cold-start storms — owner: Acme platform (Sarah). ETA: PR/plan by Wed 5/13.

Ask: can you confirm which routes are latency-critical vs throughput-first so we can prioritize canary routing? Also confirm the final close date — we will align rollouts around your procurement sign-off.

I'll consolidate notes after answers and push an updated MAP with owners and dates.

Thanks,
Ben

Thanks Sarah — confirmed routes. Proposed short plan from infra side: 

- Warmup agent: implement a lightweight KV prefetch on the canary path for /chat/realtime (pre-populate 3 recent keys per session). Expected impact: p95 down ~18–30% on warm-started flows. (Owner: Monica)
- Canary config: start with 10% traffic to canary instance with prefetch + reduced max_batch_window=40 ms. Monitor p95 and error rate at 15-minute intervals. (Owner: Markus)
- Fallback: if p95 improves >20% and error rate <0.5% increase, promote to 30% traffic.

Action items (short list):
- Monica: deliver prefetch PR + runbook by Fri 5/14 EOD.
- Markus: provision canary instance and CI job, set metrics dashboard. ETA Thu 5/13 noon.
- Laura: coordinate hybrid quantization spike and share perf delta (p50/p95/throughput) by Fri 5/14.
- Ben / Sarah: confirm canary start window (prefer morning UTC to avoid maintenance windows).

I'll attach a short runbook once PR is up.

Monica
